- Week 2: Acceptance sprint — final acceptance tests and sign-off window (owner: Novum/Procurement).

Target: keep go-live window between 2026-09-08 and 2026-09-15 instead of 2026-09-01. If procurement clears earlier we'll accelerate.

Immediate asks for Novum (to shorten risk):
1) Share the vendor questionnaire answers you can today — we will start filling gaps now.
2) Confirm vendor security slot time so we can align Redwood reviewers.
3) Confirm which acceptance tests are mandatory vs optional for initial go-live.

Redwood commitments:
- Attaching MAP-v2.xlsx (compact plan + checkpoints).
- Rishi will send SOC2 snapshot and a short data-flow diagram by EOD tomorrow.
- If procurement needs a small operational credit for an extra week, we can discuss a limited onboarding credit — will confirm with Marissa.

If Novum is ok with the compact path we will treat this as a formal MAP rebase and update the milestone dates in HubSpot.

Best,
